title: The palette opens over the settings panel and both stay open
body:
`State` holds `menu: Option<Menu>`, `panel: Option<Panel>` and `picker: Option<Picker>` as three independent fields. `pointer_button` returns early only when the picker is open. With the panel open, a click on the frame's palette button reaches `frame_hit(Hit::Palette)` and `open_palette`, which sets `menu` without looking at `panel`. Both boxes then paint at `overlay_origin`, and keys go to the panel, since `run_key` checks the picker, then the panel, then the menu.

The fix is the issue "Menu, panel and picker become one overlay with one outcome type", which makes the state unrepresentable.
close_reason: open_palette clears the panel before it opens the menu, in b8068a1. A scripted frame comparison checked it; State cannot be built in a cargo test. decade-fbc2df later makes the two-overlay state unrepresentable.
